name: Dubsado
description: Dubsado is a client relationship and business-management platform for leads, projects, contacts, forms, proposals, contracts, invoices, payments, schedulers, workflows, email, and client portals. Service businesses use it to organize an engagement from inquiry and booking through delivery and payment.
agentUseSummary: Dubsado is not available as a direct Relay connection because its current account keys and documented automation surface are expressly for the Premier-plan Zapier integration, not a published general developer API. Relay will not collect a Dubsado Zapier key, infer private endpoints from Zapier, or claim broader data and mutation authority than Dubsado documents for that intermediary.

blocked.label: Connect Dubsado
blocked.description: Relay exposes no direct Dubsado connection until Dubsado publishes a supported developer contract.

blocked.label: Collect a Zapier API key
blocked.description: The one-time-visible key documented for the Dubsado Zapier integration is not collected or repurposed as a general API credential.

blocked.label: Access Dubsado data
blocked.description: Projects, clients, contracts, invoices, payments, forms, schedules, workflows, email, files, and portal data remain unavailable.

blocked.label: Use private or raw interfaces
blocked.description: Zapier implementation details, reverse-engineered app calls, browser automation, scraping, cookies, session material, arbitrary endpoints, and raw responses are blocked.

providerSetup.blocker: Dubsado's current official integration guidance lets an owner or admin on a Premier plan generate and delete named keys specifically on the Zapier card, then instructs the user to paste the key into Zapier. Dubsado publishes five Zapier triggers and one create-project action but no direct endpoint, schema, authentication-header, permission, quota, error, pagination, lifecycle, webhook, or redistribution contract for independent developers.
providerSetup.nextAction: Keep Dubsado unavailable and do not collect or test its Zapier keys. Re-evaluate only if Dubsado publishes a supported public API, OAuth application program, hosted remote MCP, or a documented direct integration contract with exact operations, permissions, quotas, credential lifecycle, and redistribution terms.

evidence.supports: Dubsado documents named, one-time-visible, deletable keys under the Zapier card for owner/admin users on Premier, instructs users to paste them into Zapier, and warns that anyone with a key can access Dubsado data.
Dubsado publishes five current Zapier triggers and one create-project action with mapped fields, but does not publish a direct API endpoint or independent developer schema contract.
Dubsado's official integration catalog lists conferencing, accounting, and Zapier guides and provides no public API, OAuth application program, or hosted MCP documentation.
Dubsado describes the Third party connections API key specifically as the credential used to connect through Zapier automation and documents distinct account roles and sensitive financial access.
